events.title: A Saturday With a Clipboard
events.text: A neighborhood group needs someone to count foot traffic for a small planning survey.

outcomes.text: The work was dull but dependable, and the organizer paid promptly.
You kept your time and let the opportunity pass.

events.title: The Block Looks Brighter
events.text: Volunteers are repainting benches and clearing litter from the residential park.

outcomes.text: You worked beside people you usually only pass on the street.
The organizers put your supplies straight to work.
The park still looked better when the work was done.

events.title: The Receipt Is Longer Than Usual
events.text: A few essentials cost more this week, forcing an unplanned choice at checkout.

outcomes.text: The cupboards are stocked, even if your wallet feels lighter.
You made the cheaper basket work, though it was not especially satisfying.

events.title: Money From an Old Envelope
events.text: A closed utility account finally returns a forgotten deposit.

outcomes.text: The timing could not have been better.

events.title: A Preventive Checkup
events.text: The public clinic has an opening for a low-cost health screening.

outcomes.text: The nurse catches a small issue early and gives you a practical plan.

delayed.text: Following the clinic plan has improved your health.

outcomes.text: You decide the appointment can wait.

events.title: Your Patience Is Running Thin
events.text: Small frustrations feel enormous, and sleep is no longer doing enough.

outcomes.text: Turning down extra demands gives your mind room to settle.
You finish what had to be done, but the strain follows you home.

events.title: One Manageable Step
events.text: A free neighborhood walking group welcomes beginners and anyone rebuilding their strength.

outcomes.text: You finish tired but encouraged.
A quiet day helps a little.

events.title: A Wallet Beneath the Bench
events.text: You find a wallet containing cash and an address card. Nobody seems to have noticed it yet.

outcomes.text: The owner is relieved and tells the neighborhood group about your honesty.

choices.text: Turn it in at the station

outcomes.text: You leave it with the desk officer and receive a receipt.

choices.text: Keep the cash and leave the wallet

outcomes.text: You pocket the cash, but spend the week glancing over your shoulder.

effects.reason: Cash taken from a found wallet

delayed.text: A nearby camera placed you near the missing wallet.

outcomes.text: Someone nearby recognizes you before you can walk away.

effects.reason: Cash taken from a found wallet

events.title: The Interviewer Calls Back
events.text: A hiring coordinator offers ten minutes of honest feedback on your last application.

outcomes.text: The feedback is direct, specific, and useful for your next application.
The message expires without changing anything.

events.title: Five Employers, One Gymnasium
events.text: A public job fair brings warehouse, retail, delivery, security, and office recruiters together.

outcomes.text: You leave with clearer expectations and several names to mention in applications.
You bookmark a few listings but make no new contacts.

events.title: A Deadline Starts Slipping
events.text: A task at work is behind schedule, and your supervisor asks how you plan to recover.

outcomes.text: Clear priorities help the team finish the important part on time.

choices.text: Spend four extra hours on it

outcomes.text: You recover the schedule, but sacrifice most of an evening.
The unfinished work is discovered later, costing your supervisor time.

events.title: Maya Will Put in a Word
events.text: Maya offers to mention your reliability during the next team meeting.

outcomes.text: Her specific examples carry more weight than vague praise.

choices.text: Ask to stand on your own work

outcomes.text: Maya respects the answer, even if the opportunity passes.

events.title: A Seat at the Review Table
events.text: Strong performance earns you a formal pay-and-responsibility review.

outcomes.text: Your preparation makes the decision easy: you earn a promotion and raise.
There is no raise this cycle, but your manager commits to specific targets.

choices.text: Let the review speak for itself

outcomes.text: The meeting ends with praise but no concrete change.

events.title: A Quiet Meeting With Your Supervisor
events.text: Your recent performance has slipped enough to trigger a formal warning.

outcomes.text: The expectations are demanding, but at least they are now clear.
The explanation sounds like an excuse and the warning remains.

events.title: Study Group at the Library
events.text: Other students in the workplace readiness course invite you to review together.

outcomes.text: Explaining the material out loud makes it stick.
The quiet session is useful, if less memorable.

events.title: A Conversation About House Rules
events.text: Living with family keeps costs low, but Jordan wants a clearer share of chores.

outcomes.text: The arrangement feels fairer and the house is calmer.
Jordan accepts, but reminds you that money does not wash dishes.
The room gets quiet in the uncomfortable way.

events.title: The Window Will Not Close
events.text: A warped latch leaves cold air slipping into your rented room.

outcomes.text: It takes two attempts, but the room is warm again.
A repair is promised, though not immediately.

delayed.text: The landlord finally replaces the faulty latch.

events.title: Bass Through the Wall
events.text: A new neighbor has discovered both large speakers and late nights.

outcomes.text: They apologize and lower the volume.
They take it badly and turn the volume down only a little.
It is not justice, but it is sleep.

events.title: A Cheaper Room Opens Up
events.text: Ellis hears about a modest room with lower monthly rent. Moving would cost time and a deposit.

outcomes.text: The room is real and affordable. It is now highlighted in your housing options.
You keep the privacy and the larger monthly bill.

events.title: The Number Keeps Calling
events.text: A creditor calls about your outstanding balance and asks for a concrete plan.

outcomes.text: The payment reduces the balance and buys some breathing room.
A patient representative arranges smaller scheduled payments.
The creditor refuses new terms and repeats the due date.
The silence does not make the balance disappear.

delayed.text: A late charge is added to the ignored balance.

events.title: A Plan With Actual Numbers
events.text: The public services office offers a free debt-counseling appointment.

outcomes.text: You leave with a realistic payment order instead of a pile of worries.
The same bills wait on the same table.

events.title: Not Enough for the Small Things
events.text: After essentials, there is barely anything left for transport or food.

outcomes.text: Jordan arrives with groceries and no lecture this time.
The volunteers treat the visit as ordinary, which helps more than expected.
The week crawls by and your body notices.

events.title: The Biggest Order Yet
events.text: A local event wants a large order from Street Bowl Kitchen on a tight schedule.

outcomes.text: Careful prep keeps quality high and the organizer pays in full.
The order is delivered, but rush costs consume most of the margin.
The organizer appreciates the quick, honest answer.

events.title: One Star and a Long Paragraph
events.text: A customer posts a harsh review after receiving the wrong order.

outcomes.text: The customer updates the review to mention your fair response.
Screenshots travel farther than the original complaint.
The review remains, but the mistake is much less likely to repeat.

events.title: A Supplier Wants Loyalty
events.text: A supplier offers lower ingredient prices if you commit to a longer arrangement.

outcomes.text: You secure a flexible discount without locking up all your cash.
The discount helps, though the commitment reduces flexibility.
You keep your options open.

events.title: Two Shifts, One Grudge
events.text: A scheduling disagreement between staff is beginning to affect customers.

outcomes.text: Neither person gets everything, but both accept the new schedule.
The conflict spills into a busy shift.

events.title: Ellis Has Had a Rough Week
events.text: Ellis asks whether you can spare an evening to listen, not solve anything.

outcomes.text: Ellis remembers that you did not rush the conversation.
It helps, though Ellis had hoped to see you.
Ellis says it is fine. It does not sound fine.

events.title: Who Gets Credit?
events.text: Maya presents a shared idea without mentioning your contribution.

outcomes.text: Maya apologizes and corrects the record in the next meeting.
Maya becomes defensive, but now knows you noticed.
You get credit, but the working relationship turns colder.
The meeting moves on, but resentment does not.

events.title: Nia Asks What This Is
events.text: After another long conversation, Nia asks whether the connection could be more than friendship.

choices.text: Say you want to explore it

outcomes.text: The honesty is a little scary and mostly wonderful.
Nia needs a moment, then thanks you for being clear.

events.title: Jordan Saves You a Seat
events.text: Jordan invites you to a simple family dinner with no special occasion attached.

outcomes.text: Nothing dramatic happens, and that is exactly what you needed.
Jordan understands, but makes you promise to pick a date.

events.title: Theo Questions Your Numbers
events.text: Theo thinks your business plan relies too much on a single good week.

outcomes.text: The revised plan is less exciting and far more useful.
Theo lets the subject drop, unconvinced.

events.title: An Easy Score, According to a Stranger
events.text: A stranger offers cash for carrying a sealed parcel across town and refuses to explain what it contains.

outcomes.text: The stranger disappears into the crowd, and you keep your distance.
You provide a description without placing yourself deeper in the situation.
You are paid and hear nothing more—for now.

delayed.text: Investigators trace the anonymous parcel route back toward you.

outcomes.text: Officers stop the handoff and record your involvement.

events.title: Two Investigators at the Door
events.text: Investigators ask about recent incidents connected to places you visited.

outcomes.text: Ren helps you answer carefully and truthfully without guessing.
Your account is consistent and the questioning ends.
A contradiction gives investigators another reason to return.
They leave a card. The investigation does not leave with them.

events.title: An Official Envelope
events.text: A court summons arrives after the investigation advances.

outcomes.text: Ren presents the circumstances clearly. The court imposes a fine but no jail time.
The evidence is stronger than expected. A short sentence begins next week.

effects.reason: Unable to report to work during a jail sentence

outcomes.text: The judge treats your absence seriously and issues a short sentence.

delayed.text: You are taken into custody for the missed hearing.

effects.reason: Unable to report to work during a jail sentence

events.title: A Test of Boundaries
events.text: Another inmate pressures you to hold a personal item and refuses to explain why.

outcomes.text: The moment passes after a tense silence.
The refusal causes an argument before staff separate you.
Staff move you to a different unit, trading one uncertainty for another.
A routine search discovers it and costs you time.

events.title: A Classroom Behind Locked Doors
events.text: A weekly skills class has one open seat.

outcomes.text: The routine gives the week structure and adds a useful skill.
The week feels longer without the class.

events.title: A Second-Chance Interview
events.text: A warehouse supervisor offers an interview through a reentry employment program.

outcomes.text: The supervisor cannot promise a job, but marks your next warehouse application for review.
The program gives the time slot to someone else.

events.title: A Rattle From the Mining Rig
events.text: A cooling fan on your fictional-coin mining equipment is failing.

outcomes.text: The rig returns to a steady hum before heat causes damage.
You prevent further damage but lose productive time.
The fan limps through another week, louder than before.
The fan fails and overheats a component.

events.title: A Better Airflow Layout
events.text: A hobbyist forum suggests a safer airflow layout for equipment like yours.

outcomes.text: Temperatures fall and the rig wastes a little less power.
The existing setup keeps running as before.

events.title: A Small Civic Award
events.text: The neighborhood association recognizes your steady contribution to the city.

outcomes.text: The plaque is modest; the introductions afterward are more valuable.
They mail the certificate and respect your answer.
